text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Severity P1 - routing policy misapply detected. Auto-escalation to oncall. Link: https://redwood.incidents/INC-36321

PagerDuty: Page delivered to Jon (oncall SRE) and Anya (infra).

Jon (oncall SRE): saw this in the mobile-prod alert: spike in 5xx and p95 token latency for eu-west requests. initial note: traffic being routed to a legacy model-variant in us-east due to policy fallback.

Anya (infra): confirming - metrics show an increase in cross-region hops around 11:12 UTC, concurrent connections to us-east model nodes jumped from 30->900. likely misrouted requests triggered cascade fallback to secondary region.

Kevin (runtime): I just scrolled config change logs — there was a schema migration rolled out 10:55 UTC that removed `variant_overrides` and replaced with `variant_selector` (new defaulting semantics). The migration preserved most keys but deprecated `prefer_local_variant: false` in a way that caused the service to interpret missing fields as "allow_remote_fallback: true".

Maria (prodops): customer impact summary coming: initial estimate 42 customer sessions impacted, a few enterprise tenants saw 3x token billing due to retries. Claire from Support is triaging high-touch customers.

Jon (oncall SRE): immediate mitigation plan: 1) stop the config migration rollout, 2) roll back to previous policy blob, 3) scale down us-east pools to limit cross-region capacity while we validate. Anyone object?

Anya (infra): +1. I can pin the control-plane to the previous config id and disable the migration rollout. Command I'll run:```bash
# pin control plane to previous policy
redwoodctl config rollback --id=cfg-20240315-17 --reason="rollback migration after routing regressions"
redwoodctl routing validate --all
```

Kevin (runtime): while rolling back, add a temporary validator gate to reject configs that omit `variant_overrides` until we push a graceful migration. Quick regex we can add to the config store:```json
{"requireKeys": ["variant_overrides", "routing_defaults"]}
```

Jon (oncall SRE): executing rollback now. Notifying pagerduty.

IncidentBot: rollback triggered by Jon at 11:25 UTC. Control plane pinned to cfg-20240315-17.

Anya (infra): rollback applied and control plane pinned. Running `redwoodctl routing validate --all` now.

Kevin (runtime): adding validator patch to prevent future silent-omits. Patch will be deployed to config-store service as hotfix. Patch commands:```bash
git checkout -b fix/config-validators
# add basic presence checks
apply_patch validators/require_variant_overrides.patch
make deploy-config-store
```

Maria (prodops): Customer impact update: p95 token latency for eu-west is back to baseline within 3m of rollback. Affected sessions dropped from 42->5 (stale retries). We're escalating billing/regressions to finance for reconciliation.

Claire (support): I opened a case for the top 3 tenants and sent status emails. Template used:
> "We experienced a routing regression earlier today which temporarily routed some traffic to non-local model variants. We've rolled back the configuration and are validating refunds/credits. We'll follow up with a technical postmortem."

Jon (oncall SRE): one post-rollback follow-up: confirm no config drift across regions. I'm running this quick query:```sql
SELECT count(*) FROM routing_policies WHERE last_applied > '2024-03-15T10:50:00Z' AND policy_name LIKE '%variant%';
```

Kevin (runtime): logs show a handful of services still reporting old schema parse warnings. I pushed a graceful parser that logs and defaults to safe-local mode instead of remote fallback. Deploy ID: deploy-rt-5543.

Anya (infra): deployed parser change and validator. I'll keep autoscaling throttles at 60% for us-east pools for 30m to avoid further thrash.

PagerDuty: Jon acknowledged, incident severity remains P1 until verification window closes (30m).

Jon (oncall SRE): verification window started 11:30 UTC. Monitoring: p95 latency, 5xx rate, cross-region hop count, model-variant distribution. Setting a short synthetic job to exercise EU traffic to confirm local routing:```bash
# synthetic test
ab -n 200 -c 20 https://eu-west.api.redwood/textgen?model=test-variant-local
```

Maria (prodops): early telemetry: model-variant distribution is back to expected (92% local eu-west). 5xxs down to baseline. Customer complaints: 3 high-touch tickets open, triage in progress.

Kevin (runtime): root cause draft: schema migration changed semantics for omitted/deprecated routing fields. When `variant_overrides` was missing, the new `variant_selector` defaulted to remote-friendly behavior. This caused a cascading capacity shift that amplified failover behavior and led to cross-region saturation.

Jon (oncall SRE): next action items (immediate):
- (Anya) keep control plane pinned for 2 hours and monitor.
- (Kevin) open PR to add explicit migration shim that maps `variant_overrides` -> `variant_selector` with safe defaults.
- (Maria) compile customer impact list and billing reconciliation draft.
- (Claire) update support templates and send first follow-ups.
- (Jon) coordinate postmortem and timeline.

Anya (infra): done. pin maintained. I'll post if any throttling or autoscaling triggers.

Kevin (runtime): PR opened: https://git.redwood/pr/7452 "migration-shim: preserve local-preference when migrating variant fields". Adding unit tests and integration test to simulate routing decisions on omitted fields.

Claire (support): sent initial notifications to affected customers. Response so far: one customer acknowledged, two requested ETA for fix. I replied with the rollback + verification timeline.

Jon (oncall SRE): closing the active pager at 11:50 UTC, severity downgraded to P2 for postmortem work. If metrics regress, we will reopen paging.

IncidentBot: :white_check_mark: Pager closed by Jon. Postmortem owner: Jon. Follow-up tasks assigned.

Maria (prodops): logging note for postmortem: include timeline of config migration, exact config diff, validator gap, autoscaling interactions, and customer impact table (tenant id, time window, tokens billed).

Kevin (runtime): I'll include the migration diff snippet here:
```diff
- variant_overrides:
-  - tenant_id: "*"
-    prefer_local_variant: false
+ variant_selector:
+  default: "prefer-local"
+  rules: []
```
This shows where semantics diverged when `prefer_local_variant` was not carried over.

Jon (oncall SRE): quick blameless notes: the schema change was intended to be safe, but the defaulting semantics weren't fully specified and validation didn't reject missing keys. We'll cover this in action items.

Anya (infra): action: add config-store schema enforcement and a canary rollout gate to config-migrations. (I will create a ticket: CFG-901)

Maria (prodops): action: refund batch for impacted tenants and a customer note. (Ticket: CUST-472)

Kevin (runtime): action: add integration tests for migration path and add explicit shim in migration service. (PR and ticket linked).

Claire (support): action: follow up with high-touch customers and prepare FAQ on routing behavior.

Jon (oncall SRE): good job team. I'll author the incident timeline and invite infra/runtime/prodops/support to the postmortem session tomorrow 15:00 UTC.

PagerDuty: Reminder generated for postmortem meeting.

IncidentBot: thread archived for record (incident-id INC-36321).

:information_source: Notes: no customer data exfiltration. Root cause is config semantics + missing validator. Severity reduced after rollback and mitigations. Postmortem required.
